about: Shared by web/src/lib/credits.test.ts and mobile/src/test/credits.test.ts (read by tests/test_scannable_listing.py too). creditCount(credits) is the number a course's qualification is worth, or null when there is nothing a person can make sense of: no figure, zero, a negative, or not a number. The API already sends null for those (Sprint 75); this is the clients' own guard, so a stray figure never renders as '0 credits' or 'NaN credits'. A fractional figure is kept as written (2.5).

cases.name: zero is not a number of credits
